trigger: kill-switch PUT answers 500, another operator writes the same scope before the caller reads it back, the read-back shows the caller's source with a different enabled, reason or set_by, and the caller follows "or when in doubt, repeat the PUT"
summary: The kill-switch PUT 500 advice (rest-api.md 10141-10147 and the served spec PUT 500 text, rest_api_v1.cpp 2635, both written in 753a56a1f/24065fcc7) tells a caller who cannot confirm the write to repeat the PUT, and calls the repeat safe. set_kill_switch is an unconditional INSERT ... ON CONFLICT DO UPDATE with no compare-and-set (plugin_config_store.cpp 582-584), so a repeat silently overwrites a concurrent writer (for example re-enabling a plugin another operator just stopped) and also re-stamps set_by and updated_at_ms and adds a second audit pair. Also raised by compliance-officer (no mention of the second audit pair) and sre (blind repeat is last-writer-wins). Needs: when source matches but enabled, reason or set_by differ, say another writer changed the row and do not repeat blindly; state what a repeat re-stamps.
classification_rationale: "safe to repeat" is true for the repeater's own enabled and reason only; the text presents it as unconditionally safe. Reviewer disagreement resolved: unhappy-path labelled the finding MEDIUM and happy-path judged "safe to repeat" true; the derivation (I4 base HIGH, E5/E3 no change) governs, checked against plugin_config_store.cpp 563-594 and plugin_config_routes.cpp 340-372.
